title: Split clamp collar blank for an 8 mm shaft
prompt: Split clamp collar blank for an 8 mm shaft, to be milled from aluminium: 22 mm OD, 8.1 mm bore, 10 mm thick, with a 1.5 mm wide slit cut all the way through one side so it can clamp. I'll drill and tap the M3 clamp screw across the slit myself afterwards.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
22 mm across (21.97 on the slit side), 10 mm thick
The bore is an 8.1 mm (8.0–8.2) arc: a slip fit on the 8 mm shaft
The outside is a 22 mm arc
The slit goes all the way through: the bore opens to the outside, so there is no closed hole
Four flat faces: the two slit walls plus both ends

notes: Slit strip area within the ring (x > 0, |y| ≤ a): [a√(R²−a²) + R²·asin(a/R)] − [a√(r²−a²) + r²·asin(a/r)], a = 0.75, R = 11, r = 4.05.
